messages.subject: Pennington v Crossfield — Defence served
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear James,

Please find our client's Defence, served today and filed at court. As foreshadowed, liability is denied; our client relies in particular on the sample-approval/value-engineering case and on clause 11 (exclusion of consequential loss and the £214,830 cap). We look forward to receiving your proposals for directions ahead of the CMC.

Kind regards,
Callum Voss

--
Calderbank Hughes LLP | 5 Temple Gardens, London EC4Y 9AU
